subject: Merge branch '1.0' into main
reason: The merge changes only release metadata: release notes text, the CMake project version (99.99.99 -> 1.0.0), the MODULE_VERSION constant (999999 -> 10000) and MODULE_RELEASE_STAGE string ("dev" -> "rc1") passed to RedisModule_Init, plus a whitespace-only reformat in vmsdk/src/module.cc. No command behaviour, reply format, indexing, persistence, replication or cluster path changes; the only observable difference is the constant version number reported in MODULE LIST, which is a deliberate build/release change with nothing to break. No scenario is needed.
